name: Financial Recovery
overview: Scripture reveals that financial recovery is rooted in God's faithful blessing and restoration, as He remembers His people and promises to restore their captivity (Psalms 115:12; Jeremiah 33:11). Believers are assured that their heavenly Father knows their needs and provides for them (Matthew 6:32), while the blessings promised to Abraham extend to all through faith in Jesus Christ (Galatians 3:14). This divine provision invites trust in God's mercy and a heart of praise as part of the journey toward restoration.
